svg.aria-label: The largest context at which each model still fits the card at all: weights plus KV at that context plus the 1 GiB overhead, against 15 GiB, capped by the trained length. The tick on each bar is the context the roster actually measured at — in most cases the card affords far more than was run, because the roster spends its headroom rather than its ceiling. `qwen3-30b-a3b-q3` and `mistral-24b-q4` are the two exceptions, and the reason §3 runs them at 4k
svg.title: The largest context at which each model still fits the card at all: weights plus KV at that context plus the 1 GiB overhead, against 15 GiB, capped by the trained length. The tick on each bar is the context the roster actually measured at — in most cases the card affords far more than was run, because the roster spends its headroom rather than its ceiling. `qwen3-30b-a3b-q3` and `mistral-24b-q4` are the two exceptions, and the reason §3 runs them at 4k
svg.desc: The largest context at which each model still fits the card at all: weights plus KV at that context plus the 1 GiB overhead, against 15 GiB, capped by the trained length. The tick on each bar is the context the roster actually measured at — in most cases the card affords far more than was run, because the roster spends its headroom rather than its ceiling. `qwen3-30b-a3b-q3` and `mistral-24b-q4` are the two exceptions, and the reason §3 runs them at 4k — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
